How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Hi! Normally, orders ship out in 1–3 business days, and once the label is created you’ll get a tracking email. Delivery after that is usually 4–8 business days with standard shipping.

So total timing is typically 5–11 business days. Most orders arrive sooner, but that’s the safe estimate 🙂

If you want, send me your order number starting with SM and I can help with your specific order.

If tracking never updates, here’s the best next step:

If it just shipped, give it about 2–3 business days in case the carrier hasn’t scanned it yet.
If it still shows “label created” or “info received” after that, send us your order number starting with SM so we can check it.
If there’s a delivery exception or it goes a long time with no movement, file a claim here: claims.simplemodern.com

Claims are typically resolved within 24 hours, and you’ll need your order number when you submit it 📦

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Hi! You can usually find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email we send once your order ships 📦

A few places to check:

Your inbox for an email from us with tracking details
Your spam or promotions folder
Your Simple Modern account, if you checked out while logged in

If you only have the order confirmation email, that means the order likely hasn’t shipped yet.

If you want, send me your order number starting with SM and I can help check what stage it’s in 🙂

Can I reroute the package to a different address?

Hi! If the package has already shipped, we usually can’t reroute it to a different address from chat. In many cases, the best next step is through the carrier once tracking is active.

If this was ordered from simplemodern.com, send me your SM order number and I’ll check what options are available 🙂
